text.insert: Existing process, PR, session, and knowledge endpoints remain adapters for operator workflows while the workspace adopts canonical action ids. Compatibility controls translate their result back into a ProjectStateView refresh; they do not preserve a second client-side authority model.

Legacy field aliases may keep older active sessions readable, but canonical dispatch, blocker, expected-transition, and confirmation fields win whenever present. The fixed dashboard process name remains melee-live.
The separation between available_actions and compatibility_actions is defined by
; the workspace keeps pr.adopt_legacy only in compatibility_actions.
